topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling compromises link budgets due to increased interference and congestion. Compact constellations with shorter inter-satellite distances exacerbate this issue, reducing SNR and link budget. To mitigate this effect, Interference Mitigation Techniques (IMTs) like beamforming and adaptive modulation can be designed to balance high-revenue service requirements with navigation safety margins. However, these techniques may not completely eliminate the effects of interference. Further optimization is needed through advanced design choices that balance high-revenue service requirements with navigation safety margins.
